reviews.text:
Megan was absolutely incredible for my pup Wylie and me. (I think he might like her more than he does me. 😂)

Wylie was about 5.5 months old when Megan started working with us and not only did he need the standard behavioural training any puppy would, but he's a hound mix (read: very independent) *and* was incredibly fearful of... everything.

I opted for Beyond the Dog's more expensive tier of training since that's what would cover more targeted training around his fearfulness and in just a couple of weeks, I started to see major changes. By the end of the program (about 8 weeks in total, I think?), he was a completely different dog.

I went from not being able to get him to go outside without physically carrying him there to being able to take him anywhere, walking or in the car (which also terrified him at the start). He responds to all basic commands, even without treats, and generally walks very well on leash. (He is still a puppy and can forget the rules when he's REALLY excited, but the difference is that I'm able to get him back to good form pretty quickly, which was impossible before.) The praise for his behaviour from the people we meet is *constant*.

Megan never made me feel like any of my (many) questions were dumb and I really appreciated the one-on-one time she spent with Wylie, as well as our sessions together. (Humans need training too. :)

I saw a lot of reviews saying it's pricey but worth it, and I'm here to add to them. If you are able to make the investment, I can all but *promise* you won't regret it.

Thank you Beyond the Dog and Megan!!

i can only recommend beyond the dog and megan!  pickle had some issues with reactivity on walks and in public in addition to a couple of biting/nipping events and i knew how important getting these behaviors fixed was for his quality of life.  megan helped us both learn how to navigate the big emotions in his little body and he is like a different dog!  i am so looking forward to cooler weather so he can start having his adventures in public that i’ve always wanted to have with him.

what i love about this program is that megan came to us (and was flexible with my night shift schedule) and trained not only my dog, but me too.  it’s important for me to be able to continue to utilize the skills that we both learned so that neither of us fall back on bad habits.

we loved working with megan and she felt like a friend by the end of our time together!  thank you so much for everything (including this precious picture of pickle)!

We cannot recommend Beyond the Dog and our trainer, Megan, highly enough.

We originally reached out because our dog, Gordon, struggled significantly with guests coming into our home and was extremely fearful of walking outside. On our first day of training, I couldn't even walk him to the mailbox without him retreating and pulling me back toward the house. It felt overwhelming, and I worried that I wasn't able to give Gordon the life he deserved.

Today, Gordon is a completely different dog. Thanks to Megan's guidance, he is happy, confident, and excited about exploring the world. We can now walk him around our neighborhood, take him to parks, and enjoy experiences that once felt impossible. His world has opened up so much. Instead of fearing walks, he now waits eagerly by the door when he knows it's time to go out.

Megan also helped us create a clear, practical protocol for having guests over, which has made a tremendous difference in our home. Looking back, I wish I had taken video on day one and compared it to where Gordon is today because the transformation is almost unrecognizable.

What truly sets Megan apart is not only her expertise but also her compassion. It is obvious that she genuinely loves her work and deeply cares about the dogs and families she helps. She was incredibly patient with me throughout the process and gave me the confidence and tools I needed to work successfully with Gordon. I went from feeling overwhelmed and discouraged to feeling capable and empowered.

After completing our initial training program, we knew immediately that we wanted to continue working with Megan. She has since helped us with our new puppy as well, and everywhere we go people comment on how well-behaved she is for such a young dog. We continue to schedule maintenance sessions as needed, not only because of the incredible results we've seen, but because Megan has truly become part of our little pack. Our dogs absolutely adore her.

If you're considering training for your dog, Megan and Beyond the Dog are worth every penny. The impact they've had on our dogs and on our confidence as pet parents has been life-changing.

Our experience with Beyond the Dog, especially with Megan, was nothing short of exceptional. At just five months old, our Chihuahua puppy has made incredible progress with manners, leash walking, and socialization. The training has been just as valuable for us as it has been for our pup.

Megan is kind, patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely fun to work with throughout the process. We’re so grateful for her guidance and highly recommend Beyond the Dog and Megan to anyone looking for thoughtful, effective dog training.

The one on one training sessions Megan gave ourselves and our foster dog Goose were incredibly helpful. Goose needed help with leash training and we were having problems stopping him mouthing and jumping on us. The lessons Megan provided corrected all these behaviors. Goose adored Megan and responded so well to the training. We actually started to get compliments from other dog walkers as they could see the progress he was making. Goose found his forever home last week. We would not hesitate to hire Megan again should our next foster require it.
Douglas, thank you for your five star review!

I cannot say enough amazing things about this dog training company and our trainer, Megan! From the very first consultation, she was professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. You can immediately tell they truly love what she does and deeply care about the dogs she works with.

Our trainer, Megan was incredibly patient, clear in their instructions, and always took the time to explain. The training methods were effective, structured, and easy for us to follow at home. We saw noticeable improvements in our dog’s behavior much faster than we expected!

What really stood out was how personalized the training was. They took the time to understand our dog’s temperament and our specific goals, and they tailored everything accordingly. The communication throughout the process was excellent, and we always felt supported.

If you’re looking for a trustworthy, results-driven, and compassionate dog training team, this is it. I would highly recommend them to anyone who wants real, lasting results and a stronger bond with their dog!

We brought a new Bernedoodle puppy, Rosie, into our lives knowing our family needed something special. She turned out to be exactly what we hoped for, but also presented us with some challenges. Rosie is filled with so much love but also so much anxiety!

When we reached out to Beyond the Dog for help, we knew we needed guidance, but we had no idea the impact it would have on all of us. Megan, our trainer, was truly incredible. Rosie’s biting, jumping, chewing, and other puppy behaviors improved tremendously through her training. But the greatest transformation we’ve seen has been in Rosie’s anxiety and reactivity.

Megan didn’t just train Rosie, she challenged both of us. She encouraged us to visit parks, stores, and other social settings, helping to build Rosie’s confidence as well as my own. She guided us through crate training so we could leave the house without accidents or constant worry. Just a few weekends ago, we were able to attend our sons’ piano recital for four hours, which is something we once thought was impossible. Now we can confidently leave Rosie in her crate to attend our boys’ practices, games, and other outings.

Megan has given our family a sense of freedom and for that we are forever grateful. While we will miss our weekly sessions with her, we know she has equipped us with the tools we need to move forward.

The Beyond the Dog program is truly amazing, and Megan is the absolute best! We can’t thank her enough for everything she’s done for Rosie and our entire family!

We could not have higher praise for Megan and Beyond the Dog. Before the training started, Megan told us that she would have our dog walking down busy trails like the Katy Trail within 5 weeks. We didn’t believe that was possible because our dog was so reactive around other dogs, people, etc. Megan completely transformed our dog. He is so much calmer than he was before, and we can now take him places we never thought we could. Cannot recommend Megan and Beyond the Dog enough!!

Megan is nothing short of a lifesaver. Our pup, Katy, was on the streets for about 3 months before we were able to trap her and bring her home (no clue what her first 3ish years looked like). She was terrified, skittish, shut down/withdrawn, and zero in confidence. Before we started with Megan, Katy’s world was so small, and we were at a loss, our other trainer was at a loss, and all we wanted was to give Katy the life she hadn’t yet had.

Megan gave her all that and more. She’s no longer terrified of leashes, the outside, or our apartment. Just a week into our sessions with Megan, she started wagging her tail. She’s now so confident on walks, exploring the apartment, and has started showing her silly personality.

I credit Megan entirely - we obviously followed her advice outside of sessions to a T, but she so thoughtfully curated how to work with our pup, and drove so much progress in her sessions with Katy. Megan is brilliant in her work, and I trust her wholeheartedly. I can’t thank or recommend her enough!!!!

I cannot recommend Beyond the Dog highly enough. This is truly a top-tier dog training and behavior modification service that has delivered genuine, life-changing results. If you are looking for professional dog trainers with unparalleled expertise in addressing complex behavioral issues, look no further.

Our dog, Eos, struggled intensely with skittishness and high-level anxiety around busy environments. Before working with Megan, her training felt like an uphill battle, and we were struggling to help her build confidence.

The training program was exceptional. The approach was perfect for positive reinforcement and was highly customized to Eos's specific needs and our lifestyle. Megan was patient, deeply knowledgeable, and masters at communicating not just what to do, but why the techniques work.

The transformation in Eos's confidence was beyond our expectations. She is significantly less reactive, her overall skittish behavior has vastly improved- she is now able to enjoy walks and new experiences that were previously impossible. This improvement is a direct result of the invaluable guidance we received from Megan & Beyond the Dog.

We are incredibly grateful for training. For anyone seeking the best dog trainers who focus on long-term behavioral health and positive outcomes, Beyond the Dog deserves your highest recommendation. Thank you for giving Eos, and us, a more comfortable, confident life! ❤️

Our dog just finished training program today and we’re absolutely thrilled with the results! Megan is a magical trainer — in just a few weeks, she helped turn our pup into one that behaves like a service dog. We’re so thankful for her patience, skill, and the love she puts into her work. Highly recommend Megan if you’re looking for someone who truly understands dogs!

Megan was an incredible trainer for our 6 month old Doberman. She was extremely knowledgeable, patient and went above and beyond what was expected. She worked with our puppy on obedience and behaving around new visitors to the house, interacting with people and other animals in public, and off leash recall training. Highly recommend

Hi Abby, we sincerely apologize if you had a negative experience with us. We ask that you please give us a call at 945-269-0506 to share your feedback and give us an opportunity to provide a solution. Thank you!

Beyond expectations!! Megan is a miracle worker. Our 1.5 year old shelter pup was unwalkable because he was so reactive that it was dangerous for everyone involved (he pulled me over and ran across a busy street). After the first week, we already saw major improvement. Now, we get compliments from strangers not only about how cute he is but about how calm and well behaved he is! The in-home structure of the program was extremely convenient for our busy schedules. The psychology based training philosophy is incredibly effective and felt kind. Megan was so patient, helpful, and knowledgeable. I always knew our pup was in good hands, and he absolutely loves her (he was more excited to see her when she came for her last follow up lesson than he is to see me come home half the time). This was truly an incredible experience that helped us be the dog owners we want to be. I can’t recommend Megan enough!!!

If we could give Megan and Beyond the Dog more than 5 stars, we would! Megan has been excellent working with our 2 dogs!

We recently rescued a puppy. We were nervous about how we would integrate our new dog into our busy lives and how we would make sure our new puppy would get along with our existing dog. Megan did an incredible job not only training our dogs but giving us the tips and tricks we needed to build on her excellent training. Megan made the process of training our puppy and integrating our new puppy into our lives an easy process.

It was clear working with Megan that she wants the best for us and our dogs. She asked us questions about what our goals were, what was working and what wasn't over the course of a week, and followed up with detailed notes for us so we could build on her training in-between sessions.

Working with Beyond the Dog and Megan is one of the best decisions we have made and we would recommend her to anyone looking for dog training!

My husband and I were nearing our wits end when it came to integrating our new dog into the household. I found Beyond The Dog and with such great reviews and after speaking on the phone with them, we ultimately decided to move forward with the 5 week inclusive program. Let me tell you — NIGHT AND DAY difference and WORTH EVERY CENT!!!

Megan M. is an absolute rockstar and you could tell she really knows what she's doing and that she really cares. It was so great getting to know her and watch how she works. You would think with this being a dog company they wouldn't work too much with the cats, but they were fully integrated from the start.

We just wrapped up our second follow-up today so we are officially all done and it was a bittersweet day for all. (Cincy, Mister, and Kei obviously don't know she isn't coming back, but I know they'll be confused come next week.) Mixed emotions now that we've reached the end, but also so proud of how far we've all come in just 5 weeks.

Thank you Beyond The Dog and thank you Megan!!! ❤️

We had Claire help our dog with her separation anxiety over a 5-week program, and extra three weeks of follow-up appointments. She is so knowledgeable, competent, and has an amazing personality to boot. Our dog has completely transformed thanks to her training and guidance and we are now able to leave her for 4 hours at a time, while we were not able to leave her for 3 minutes before. The training was worth every cent!
Thank you for the excellent rating!

We had an absolutely fantastic experience with Claire as our dog trainer for the “All-Inclusive Puppy” program! She worked with our 4-month-old Golden Retriever puppy, Remi, who was struggling with typical puppy issues like biting, jumping, and not listening. Claire didn’t just address these behaviors—she went above and beyond by teaching Remi advanced manners like how to properly greet guests, go to his place, wait at open doors, walk calmly without fear or anxiety, and stop eating things he shouldn’t.
Claire was always professional, kind, attentive, and punctual. Her genuine love for dogs and passion for her work truly shine through. Claire tailored the training program to fit our specific needs and concerns and patiently answered every question we had along the way. Her expertise and dedication made such a positive difference, and we now have a much more well-behaved and confident pup!
We could not recommend Claire enough—she’s truly amazing! Thank you for helping us and Remi so much!

We worked with Megan to help our adopted pup acclimate to his new home and work through separation anxiety - we were able to resolve his behavior in just 2 visits! She was a great listener, highly knowledgeable and flexible throughout the process. We left feeling empowered and much closer to our dog. I would highly highly recommend trying Beyond the Dog :)

I cannot recommend Claire highly enough! As a behavioral specialist, she worked wonders with my puppy, Brownie. From the very first session, it was clear that Claire possesses expert knowledge and a genuine passion for what she does.

She took the time to understand Brownie’s unique personality and tailored each training session to suit the needs of our family lifestyle. Her practical and compassionate techniques focused on positive reinforcement, making learning fun for Brownie. Claire also gave me invaluable tips and guidance on reinforcing good behavior at home.

Thanks to her patience and expertise, Brownie has transformed into a well-behaved and joyful companion. If you’re looking for someone who goes above and beyond to ensure the best for your pet, Claire is the one to call. She’s truly a gem in the world of puppy training!

We had an online training session with Megan, and our experience was fantastic! Our dog, Bear, had been experiencing an extreme fear of outside noises since the fireworks during July 4th. Over time, she had been improving but was still …
Thank you for the excellent rating!

We called Beyond the Dog in desperate need of help three weeks before an international move. We wanted our Westie (about 18lbs) to ride in the cabin with us, which requires him to stay in the airline carrier. We had been working with him …

Claire has been an amazing trainer and has done wonders with our doodle, Stanley. She has quickly helped him get over his anxieties and stubborn attitude! Stanley has quickly learned commands and is now confident, comfortable and obedient. …

We were having trouble with our cat urinating outside of her litter box.  We had 2 on-line sessions with Megan and we were able to figure out the problem and solve it!  Megan was fantastic with our meetings and she followed up throughout the weeks to see how thing were going.  I would 100% recommend.

Beyond the dog trainers were awesome! They worked with both our dachshunds and each made so much progress. They have skills we can now continue to practice and implement. I appreciate their service so much!

Meghan and her team are exceptional. Such expertise and knowledge with our dog and also in educating (and training) us! Clear and efficient communication with scheduling and follow-up. All contributing to great results and success with our dog. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
